# BabyLM eval set {#sec-eval} ::: {.callout-important} ## AI-generated — not for publication The code and prose in this book were written by an AI agent under human direction; not line-by-line verified; must not be published or cited as-is. ::: ::: {.callout-warning} ## Preliminary & unvetted analysis Exploratory analyses of preliminary work; numbers not independently validated; check before use. ::: 400 adult CHILDES utterances from corpora in `tokens_filled.parquet` that are absent from childes-db 2021.1 (Champaign\, EHS\, Edinburgh\, FMB\_book\, FMB\_home\, Sekali). Each construction uses its best 10 adult occupants (or fewer if fewer pass the filter): ≥50% of that verb's adult schematic VAC tokens are in the frame, ranked by adult frame frequency. Items are round-robin stratified across those verbs. Five distractors per item have <10% adult share in the same frame and are inflected like the original verb. Proper nouns, child speakers, fragments, fillers, and unintelligible `xxx` tokens are excluded.
